# Willi's Ski & Board

> > Family-owned Pittsburgh ski and snowboard shop since 1970, offering equipment, apparel, and expert services across three Pennsylvania locations including Seven Springs Mountain Resort.

Founded by Willi and Linda Klein in Castle Shannon, Willi's specializes in premium brands like Atomic, Burton, Nordica, and Icebreaker, with professional boot fitting, tuning services, and a loyalty rewards program. The shop serves the Pittsburgh area and Seven Springs ski community with both retail locations and slopeside convenience.
